## Summary
Lenses checked: correctness, silent-failure, tests, comments.
The new flag should honor `ARCHIVE_EXCLUDE`, because its fixed empty default ignores the required CI configuration interface.

## Changes
The pull request adds repeatable filename exclusions, skip logging, flag documentation, and tests. This review read the tests without running them.

## Critical
(none)

## Important
- cli/main.py:17 — correctness — Read the exclusion default from ARCHIVE_EXCLUDE — With `ARCHIVE_EXCLUDE=*.log` and no `--exclude`, you archive matching log files because `default=[]` ignores the environment. This violates “must also take its default from an `ARCHIVE_<NAME>` environment variable” (`.agents/skills/cli-flags/SKILL.md:11`). — CI jobs that configure exclusions through the required environment interface include files they intended to omit from archives.
